steps.content: Euphoria may be a luxury multi-deck cruise ship, but for dancers like Sallie, their world is limited to the stage, bar, backstage area, cafeteria, and employee lounge.
Only when they are chosen by a guest do they get a chance to enter the luxury suites or accompany the VIPs in other recreation areas.
Many dancers are more than willing to get close to the guests. It means a period of freedom, money, and indulgence.

For the guests seeking pleasure on the ship, there's no difference between day and night. The bar is always the most popular spot, a place for encounters, flirting, and discreet exchange of information.
Sallie takes out the lip balm Milly gave her and stares at it.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Protect me... will it really work? This... honey lip balm?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: When I put the honey on you just now... what did you see?
She hates to admit it, but Sallie had thought of Theodore.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Hm? Are you blushing? Hehe, don't be shy. Whether seasoned players or heartless fools, anyone who touches my <color=#fb9259>honey</color> will see the one they love. Well? Is your head full of Theodore now?
Milly draws closer, gently stroking Sallie's arm. Sallie flinches and takes a step back, the spot Milly touched suddenly feeling very uncomfortable.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: At first, my honey only numbed people. Mr. E said my ability is mild mind control. I can control the thoughts of anyone who touches the honey.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: But it's more than that. Your body, your mind... they will only respond to that one person.
Milly winks. Sallie realizes something and suddenly blushes.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: ...What do you mean?
Milly smiles sweetly and offers no further explanation.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: It doesn't matter. Like I told you, the guests only come to talk with me about love. Because that's all they can do.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: If you're really scared, use this to protect yourself.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Just find a way to apply it to a guest's skin, and it will flip their true love switch. And when that happens... they won't have room in their heads for any other nasty thoughts. People in love are always the sweetest and most honest.
...So it's basically a tool for extracting information.
Sallie hovers near the bar, trying to identify a guest who might give up information.

steps.speaker: Flirtatious Guest
steps.content: Well hello there, sweetheart. Haven't we met somewhere before?
A guest suddenly extends his hand, blocking Sallie's path. She takes his arm, using the gesture to dab the lip balm onto his wrist.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Oh, my. Your hands are rather dry, sir.
The moment the lip balm touches his skin, the man freezes as if struck by lightning, and his eyes suddenly grow... tender.

steps.speaker: Flirtatious Guest
steps.content: ...You know, I'm not the type to fool around.
Sallie blinks with feigned innocence.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: What's wrong? Are you... thinking of someone? Is there a love you need to confess?
Her questions touch his heart. The man clutches his waist with one hand, the other trembling against his mask. Tears glisten in his eyes as if he's seeing a love long lost.

steps.speaker: Flirtatious Guest
steps.content: I've... been looking for someone.

steps.speaker: Flirtatious Guest
steps.content: You look so much like her. When I saw you, I can't help but move closer. But I shouldn't lie to myself... I've had twenty-seven lovers since, but none of them could ever replace her...
Sallie's eyes go wide. As the man's nose begins to run, she quickly grabs a tissue and hands it to him.

steps.speaker: Flirtatious Guest
steps.content: Oh... you're such a sweet girl. Just like she was...
Then, things get strange. The guest pulls her over to the bar and asks Cassian for two cocktails.

steps.speaker: Flirtatious Guest
steps.content: I gave her riches enough to fill a city, but all she wanted was for me to light a hundred bonfires for her... I bought her a mansion, but she told me she was still lonely...
He rambles on and on about his one true love while boasting about what a romantic and compassionate partner he was.
Sallie plasters on a smile, throwing in a ditzy comment here and there. Soon, the man passes out drunk, slumped over the bar.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Whew... I wondered why they just wanted to chat with you... So this is what you meant by the true love switch...
From another corner of the bar, Milly turns her head as if she'd sensed someone watching her. She catches Sallie's exasperated, amused stare and flashes an innocent, playful smile.
